timeline_timezone: Europe/Berlin (UTC+01:00), consistent with kernel audit epoch timestamps and the host game records; journal text itself omits the offset.

timeline.observation: Graphics ring timeout reported as soft-recovered.
4515 init_user_pages failures; ten gfxhub RLC page faults, PASID 9484. No process owner is identified for those faults.
MES queue removal/addition failures, failed KFD quiesce/resume and SDMA0 timeout; GPU reset begins.
MODE1/ASIC reset fails; GPU Recovery Failed: -62. Sunshine reports vkQueueSubmit failed: -4.
SDMA1 timeout starts another GPU reset; no successful reset completion is present in this archive.
Kernel reports Xorg, Sunshine capture/session threads and reset worker blocked. Xorg is waiting in amdgpu display mode handling; reset worker is waiting in dm_suspend.
Sunshine service reports processes remain after final SIGKILL; service restart attempts did not recover those threads.

attribution.correlation: GoT started at 13:42:45.269541 UTC and its observer stopped after 42.378 seconds, within three seconds of the 14:43:25 local soft-recovery message. That kernel message has no PID attribution.
attribution.later_fault_owner: UNKNOWN; PASID 9484 has no owner mapping in this archive. Blocked llama-server processes and KFD errors do not by themselves prove Ollama caused the failure.
attribution.latest_verified_binary: dbf5c545138b5bd46af1b0fb174121d563c5f1a2 / SHA256 b34a9a539b88c5fb0dab9dc1cd597ca98f88e9049dbba1ed030671a2cb51d32d; the build started after the failed reset and both game requests stopped before launch.
attribution.production_fix_from_this_archive: None; no shader, guest address or invalid renderer command is identified. Do not invent a title/vendor workaround or claim the kernel crash is fixed.

confirmed_host_blocker: GPU recovery failed and graphics/reset threads remained blocked in the kernel, explaining the later unresponsive X display. Repeated Sunshine service stops failed to terminate the blocked threads. A session-preserving recovery is not demonstrated by these files.

collector_defect.correction: Add a separate bounded journalctl GPU/DRM/hung-task filter before selecting 600 matches, retaining the original unfiltered capture too. This avoids losing reset evidence behind the later unrelated audit stream.

new_preflight: Read display-process task state twice 250 ms apart. Persistently D-state tasks must have identical process ID, thread ID and start time. Stop before X11/VRAM/game work and retain read-only diagnostics. Transient waits, exited threads and reused IDs do not trigger this stop. No GPU-vendor condition selects emulator behavior.
